summary: Loop 009 had no mission file: it was run on the owner's requests of 2026-11-18 and 19 ('oui go', 'mets-moi tout ça en ligne'). Versions 0.9.0 to 0.10.2. The IPO price of $83 was recorded from the press (AP), then the final prospectus (Form 424B4, dated Nov 18, filed Nov 19) became the page's filing, extracted by the same code; the page computes at the IPO price only and HISTORY lists what changed from Amendment No. 3. On the listing morning, a Yahoo Finance placeholder ($83.00 with no volume) was shown as a last quote; fixed in 0.10.1. At the owner's request the market panel shows before the first trade (0.10.2).
delivered: 0.9.1: offer as priced from the final cover.
0.10.0: data/facts/p424b4.json, the extractor taught the final prospectus's wording; calc, reconcile and render without a range (D-037).
0.10.1: a Yahoo price counts only once shares traded.
0.10.2: the market panel before the first trade.
